newsitem.title: SPAIN: RALLYING-PANIZZI TAKES EARLY LEAD IN SPANISH RALLY.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-PANIZZI TAKES EARLY LEAD IN SPANISH RALLY.

text.p: Frenchman Gilles Panizzi took a surprise lead on the opening day of the Rally of Spain on Monday as the Peugeot team upstaged the main championship challengers.
As the event began with a tough drive through the mountains above the coastal town of Lloret de Mar, Frenchman Francois Delecour led Peugeot team mate Panizzi for the two opening stages.
But Delecour made a mistake on the third stage, the 10-km Les Llosses run, and ran off the road. He lost more than two minutes and dropped out of the top 10.
Panizzi kept up his impressive form to extend a slender margin over the Mitsubishi of reigning world champion Tommi Makinen of Finland to 16 seconds by the end of the fourth stage.

Briton Colin McRae was in third place, just one second behind Makinen, after an uneventful morning where the only major problem encountered by the championship frontrunners was when Italian Piero Liatti suffered a puncture on the opening stage.
He recovered to end the fourth stage in fourth position overall, just one second behind McRae.
The afternoon's two remaining stages will see the teams return to Lloret de Mar where they will have an overnight halt.
